en: Procrastination is usually cognitive avoidance — we postpone because focus gets easier as the deadline gets closer, and the short-term relief of putting it off rewards the delay.

Perfectionism drives a lot of it: 'it must be right' makes starting feel dangerous. The fix combines skills you already have — break the task down, set a realistic goal for one step, and challenge the perfectionist thought.

title.en: Pros and cons of now vs later

en: Take one task you are avoiding. Write the pros and cons of doing it now versus later.
Use breakdown plus one rational response on a dreaded task this week.
What is likely to get in the way this week, and what will you do when it happens?
